name: pos-bar-cases-by-day
note: Cases by day over 30 days with daily Results on 28: 28 values, one of them 0 (ZERO_DAY), and 2 not run. The first case is at the window's first instant and the last at its last second; one case is written at +05:00 and falls on its UTC day.

name: pos-line-cases-by-day
note: The same chart as a line, with the mark as an object.

name: pos-point-sum-by-day
note: The sum of a case field by day.

name: pos-rect-outcome-by-day
note: A rect: two cells at the same x and different y are two groups; a run day with no case of one outcome lists it as 0, and a not-run day lists every outcome as not run.

name: pos-bar-color-series
note: A color series: a key with no rows on a run day is listed as 0.

name: pos-bar-by-outcome
note: Two categories and no time axis: a comparison, which carries the derived label like every chart.

name: pos-bar-month
note: One utcyearmonth unit over a whole-month window: run, since daily Results fall in it.

name: pos-case-on-a-not-run-day
note: A case dated on a day with no daily Result: the day is not run (spec §5.1) and draws no value; the case stays in the population.

name: pos-plan-without-window
note: A plan with no window node: no day reads "not run"; a day without a row reads 0, the 2 days with no daily Result included.

name: pos-plan-with-two-windows
note: A plan with two window nodes: no day reads "not run", and the chart's window lies inside both.

name: pos-window-ends-9999-12-31
note: A window that ends on the last day a date can name: every unit is listed, and the walk over the days stops there.

name: neg-transform-expr
note: A filter given as an expression string.

name: neg-data-url
note: Data from a URL.

name: neg-params
note: A selection parameter.

name: neg-calculate
note: A calculate transform.

name: neg-local-time-unit
note: A local (non-UTC) time unit.

name: neg-week-unit
note: A week unit.

name: neg-mean
note: An aggregate outside count and sum.

name: neg-tooltip
note: A tooltip channel.

name: neg-no-aggregate
note: No channel aggregates.

name: neg-two-aggregates
note: Two channels aggregate.

name: neg-case-field-without-type-filter
note: The case chart without its record-type filter: the daily Results have no statement.outcome (check 1 runs before the population).

name: neg-sum-of-string
note: A sum over a string field.

name: neg-range-field-without-offset
note: A range filter on a field that is a timestamp with no offset.

name: neg-window-differs-from-seal
note: The chart's window, restated in the transform, ends a day before the sealed window.

name: neg-window-not-restated
note: The statement's window differs from the transform's range filter.

name: neg-month-window-not-whole-months
note: A utcyearmonth chart whose window runs from 2026-09-02 to 2026-09-30.

name: neg-runs-missing
note: A temporal chart over a one-window plan that names no run records.

name: neg-runs-field-differs-from-window
note: Runs dated by statement.generated_at; the sealed window field is event_time_claim.

name: neg-runs-on-plan-without-window
note: Runs on a plan with no window node.

name: neg-runs-on-plan-with-two-windows
note: Runs on a plan with two window nodes.

name: neg-population-counts-runs-too
note: A count of cases by day with no record-type filter: the daily Results pass the transform too, and the stated count holds only the cases.

name: neg-population-off-by-one
note: The stated population is one short.

name: neg-not-run-stated-as-zero
note: A not-run day stated as 0: the drawing the checker exists to refuse.

name: neg-value-differs
note: One stated value is one more than the data.

name: neg-group-listed-twice
note: A group listed twice.

name: neg-group-missing
note: A zero group left out of the stated values.

name: neg-row-withheld
note: The bundle withholds one row's record from this audience.

name: neg-no-dataset
note: The Result names no dataset.

name: neg-plan-window-without-params
note: The plan's window node carries no params.
